evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Long videos spanning tens of minutes to hours far exceed the context window of today's vision-language models, and the standard remedy of sparse uniform frame sampling discards exactly the fine-grained evidence that specific questions depend on.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Across five long-video understanding benchmarks, VTree consistently improves the accuracy of diverse vision-language backbones while substantially reducing the context length and execution time required for each question.
